contract.review_scope: Body-level static contract; transitive application and called-module completeness are separate.
contract.purpose: Return the first available unit-of-measure set from location, item, class or storage template.
inputs_defaults: item/itemClass nvarchar(50), company/lot/location/warehouse nvarchar(25), containerId nvarchar(50), classKnown nchar(1); no defaults.
null_and_invalid_input_behavior: Multiple different rows with same quantityUM violate local return-table primary key even after DISTINCT across all fields. ExplicitNULL source fields bypass declared defaults; duplicate template scalar results can error. Missing template can produce empty table.

Company-specific stage suppresses class/generic alternatives once any rows exist. Missing item may still reach coded template fallback. Zero treat-full substitutes template value; NULL treat-full is retainedNULL.
output_shape: Table14 fields with QUANTITYUM primary key, conversion/measurement/treatment metadata and source code0..4. Defaults apply only to omitted columns in final template insert.

ordered_branches.explanation: If no ITEM row exists for supplied item regardless of company, resolve cross-reference item without company filter; otherwise retain supplied item.

When location/warehouse supplied, resolve optional logistics inventory by item/company/lot/location without warehouse, read TRACK_CONTAINERS, and if qualifying location UOMs exist insert DISTINCT rows/source0 then return. Untracked N allows general location rows; tracked Y requires supplied container and inventory match.
Read item storage template; NULL uses coded default. If exact-company item UOM exists, insert/source1 and return; else for non-NULL company try companyNULL item units/source2.
If class-known flag is NULL/not an affirmed coded form, reload item class; if class units exist insert/source3 and return.
Otherwise insert template unit/sequence/treat-full/source4 using return-table defaults for omitted measurements. In item/class stages TREAT_FULL_PCT=0 invokes scalar template lookup by sequence.

contract.status_and_quantity_effects: No persistent status, inventory quantity or permissions mutation; output is the stated scalar or returned table.
configuration_scope_and_precedence: Source0 location,1 exact-company item,2 generic item,3 class,4 storage template. Caller must not assume a merged complete UOM set or stable ordering.
error_and_return_handling: No explicit exception handler or application error code; conversion, arithmetic and called-function errors propagate.
contract.transaction_ownership: No explicit transaction, commit, rollback, savepoint, TRY/CATCH or XACT_ABORT is introduced by this body; caller/session semantics remain authoritative.
concurrency: No persistent mutation or lock protocol; reads, if any, follow caller/session isolation. Function result is not evidence of caller authorization or process execution.
contract.trigger_behavior: No persistent DML or DML trigger activation in this body.
external_handoffs_and_gaps: Coded default-template literal withheld; actual configuration and container-tracking choices unobserved.
